answers.how: T4 R2 requires the reconciliation to carry a claim register that names each work lane, so a published document must name the lanes of the other agents; that is an agent label in a public repository, and docs/scope-one/RECONCILIATION.md and the programme DECOMPOSITION.md carry it already
the note texts of the manifest mapping rows use work-lane labels as owners; the same labels leak through the manifest, which is not hashed and so can be corrected without a new spec
